Field Descriptions

DATA_3_2 - Descriptor payload bytes 2-3

Bytes 2-3 hold the first descriptor-specific payload bytes for the selected DEVICE_ID type. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_ID.

VENDOR_SPECIFIC_STR_LENGTH - Vendor specific string length

Byte 1 reports the optional vendor string length. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_ID.

DESC_TYPE - Initial descriptor type

Byte 0 selects the DEVICE_ID encoding such as PCI, IANA, UUID, PnP, ACPI, or NVMe-MI. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_ID.
